value.title: Microsoft Teams: New meeting chat experience for external participants

details.name: Summary
details.value: Microsoft Teams: New meeting chat experience for external participants

details.name: Platforms
details.value: Web, Desktop, Mac

body.content:
We are updating the meeting chat experience for external participants.

When this will happen:

  • Targeted release: early November 2026
  • General availability: late November 2026

How this will affect your organization: External participants will see chat history from the time they join.

What you need to do to prepare: Review your external access policies and update your training.

value.title: (Updated) Exchange Online: Retirement of Basic authentication for SMTP AUTH client submission

details.name: Summary
details.value: (Updated) Exchange Online: Retirement of Basic authentication for SMTP AUTH client submission

details.name: Platforms
details.value: Web, Desktop, Mac

body.content:
SMTP AUTH client submission with Basic authentication will be retired.

What you need to do to prepare: Move devices and applications that send mail with SMTP AUTH to OAuth, or to a connector-based relay.

 

Use the SMTP AUTH clients report to find affected senders.
